_readme: The win. Two bars at 140bpm - about three and a half seconds - and the only tune here that
is NOT written to loop, because it is played once and hands the room back (see
AudioBus.play_music_then). That is a property of the CALL rather than of this file: there
is nothing in the format saying 'one-shot', deliberately, because the same tune could be
The genre's rising ta-da: a triplet-feel pickup climbing the A minor triad, then a held
resolution on the octave. It ends on a long note rather than trailing off, which is what
makes the note's own release the ending - Tune.render writes no fade tail, so a tune that
stopped mid-phrase would simply cut, and the held A is why it does not.
Same key as the theme and the fight, for the reason skirmish states: one soundtrack.
The drum is on the first bar only. A roll under the held note would keep the ear waiting
for something more, and what comes next is the map's own theme coming back.
